digest.component_or_area: code-review criteria routing and threshold calibration
propositions: correctness and edge-cases are unmapped base-reviewer dimensions resolving to the default 0.95 threshold instead of their measured blocking threshold of 0.54
measured friction at 0.54 is 4.04% for correctness and 1.74% for edge-cases, both within the 8.0% operator-accepted budget recorded on tests criterion
concurrency criterion is routed but advisory; remeasurement at 0.54 yields only 1 surviving finding, below the MIN_N=25 calibration floor, so it remains advisory
routing entries for correctness and edge-cases must be added to criteria_routing.json with blocking_enabled true at 0.54 threshold to match measured block-impact

replay_code_v4_would_block.py hard-codes its blocking set and will desynchronize from actual routed posture when routing changes; must derive it from registry.routing_index() filtered on blocking_enabled
the canonical criterion vocabulary widens via registry.effective_criteria() when routing keys are added, impacting downstream criterion-preview and eval modules
